AnyAPI.Description: Native mod framework for Anymaker 0.1.27; faster scene reads, the game's own clock and weather for sky and lights, crash-safe graphics passes, and new scene services (lighting 4, effects 3, controls 4, antialiasing 3, timing 2, GPU info 2) for graphics mods.

AnyGraphics.Description: Graphics overhaul with ocean reflections, smoother local lights, defaults picked for your GPU and presets from Off to Cinematic plus Soft & warm and Custom, grouped in Show/Hide sub-menus: TAA, tone mapping and colour looks, light colour, shading, shadows, sky and wind in trees, depth of field, motion blur and photo mode, plus ThirdPerson's F5 third-person camera. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.

AnyCareer.Description: A survival career: earn Cash from delivery and kill jobs and small finds in houses and shops, and trade with nine traders spread over the map (Hayzeco Autoparts, Builder, Junkyard, Grocer, Medic, Marine & Air, Mod Shop, Outfitter, Gunsmith). Survival only; the host runs it, and co-op joiners with AnyCareer trade and take jobs through the host. Trader map pins need AnyMap 1.0.1 or later. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.

AnyPerformance.Description: Fixes the world slowing down and then rushing to catch up (including the stall when new terrain fills its wrecks with loot), updates the items in far-away parked vehicles less often for more FPS, and logs what causes stutters. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.

AnyMoto.Description: Motorcycle parts for the stock Motorcycle Wheel: a steering fork, a swingarm, a seat, handlebars and Lean Assist, which keeps the bike upright and leans it into turns (power and lean settings in the Properties tool). Found in loot after the first bunker. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.

AnyLights.Description: One paint tool for every colour: right-click any paint tool for the full palette and Fill, Flood, Brush, Pencil and erase modes, with Ctrl+Z undo. Glowing painted lights are still being worked on. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.
